composer.match: Match each opera to its composer.
composer.odd: Three of these operas were composed by {value}. Which one wasn't?
composer.reverse: Which of these operas did {value} compose?

rows.label: Carmen
rows.description: opera in four acts by French composer Georges Bizet
rows.hook: centers on a fiery cigarette factory worker who seduces a soldier and features the Toreador Song

rows.label: Turandot
rows.hook: features a cold princess who sets deadly riddles for her suitors and the aria Nessun dorma

rows.label: The Marriage of Figaro
rows.hook: follows a clever servant and his fiancée outwitting a philandering count on their wedding day

rows.label: Don Giovanni
rows.hook: follows a seductive nobleman dragged to hell by the statue of a man he killed

rows.label: La bohème
rows.hook: follows poor young artists in Paris and a frail seamstress whose candle blows out

rows.label: La traviata
rows.hook: tells of a doomed Parisian courtesan who falls in love and dies of consumption

rows.label: The Magic Flute
rows.hook: follows a prince and a bird-catcher on a quest, and includes the vengeful Queen of the Night

rows.label: Madama Butterfly
rows.hook: tells of a young geisha in Nagasaki abandoned by an American naval officer

rows.label: The Barber of Seville
rows.hook: opens with a fast-talking Figaro who helps a count win a closely guarded young woman

rows.label: Tosca
rows.description: opera in three acts, composed by Giacomo Puccini
rows.hook: tells of a jealous singer, her painter lover and a ruthless police chief

rows.label: Aida
rows.description: opera in four acts by Giuseppe Verdi
rows.hook: tells of an enslaved Ethiopian princess torn between a warrior she loves and her homeland

rows.label: Götterdämmerung
rows.hook: ends the four-part Ring cycle with the fall of the gods and a burning funeral pyre

rows.label: Tristan und Isolde
rows.hook: tells of doomed lovers bound by a love potion and ends with the famous Liebestod
